title: Lena and the Lost Cat
text:
Lena has a small cat named Mimi. Mimi is black and has green eyes. Every morning, Mimi sleeps on Lena's bed. Lena likes to play with her after school.

One rainy day, Lena could not find Mimi. She looked in the kitchen, the garden, and the garage. Then she heard a soft sound under the bed. Mimi was hiding there with a new toy mouse.

questions.text: Where did Lena look for Mimi?
options: In the kitchen, the garden, and the garage

questions.text: How did Lena probably feel when she could not find Mimi?
What kind of friend is Lena to Mimi?

paragraph_translations: Lena tiene un gato pequeño llamado Mimi. Mimi es negra y tiene ojos verdes. Cada mañana, Mimi duerme en la cama de Lena. A Lena le gusta jugar con ella después de la escuela.

Un día lluvioso, Lena no podía encontrar a Mimi. Buscó en la cocina, en el jardín y en el garaje. Luego escuchó un sonido suave debajo de la cama. Mimi estaba escondida allí con un juguete nuevo, un ratón de juguete.
